title: What carrying distinctions can and cannot save
claim: For the w-carry law on atom patterns: spend-only phases are ceil(sigma/w) (Ershov/Sethi-Ullman registers applied phase by phase, known-with-delta) and its doubling rounds are at least the largest Strahler number (local, elementary); the keep law's one-phase reach is black pebbling with sliding (known-with-delta); with keeping, ladders take one phase with two carried distinctions at any length and layered circuits of width W one phase with 2W at any depth (local).
standard_statement: Register allocation for expression trees (Strahler number), phase-by-phase; black pebble game with sliding on Horn derivation graphs with free sources.
